description: Version negotiation. The Hub presents a wire version; the Core resolves it to a supported governed version. An unsupported version fails closed with UNSUPPORTED_VERSION (HTTP 400). No silent downgrade, no implicit upgrade.
rules: A requested version equal to a supported governed version is accepted as-is.
A requested version present in wireToCoreVersion is mapped to its governed version.
Any other version (missing, malformed, or unknown) fails closed to UNSUPPORTED_VERSION.
